name: Afghanistan (Islamic State, 1992–1996)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and black with a gold emblem in the centre: a mosque with a mihrab and minbar within wheat sheaves, above two crossed swords.
history: Flag of the Islamic State of Afghanistan adopted on 7 December 1992 after the mujahideen took Kabul: green, white and black stripes with the mosque emblem in gold. It was displaced in Kabul by the Taliban's white flag on 27 September 1996 but continued to be flown by the Northern Alliance, and was reinstated as the national flag after the Taliban's fall in November 2001.
